description: Parcels that touch or surround a parcel (up to 60), each with its cadastral reference and centre point. Spain from the official cadastre; other countries from our own copy where we hold one. Where neighbours cannot be listed it answers supported=false with an empty list, free. One API call.

country.description: Optional country code. Omit to auto-detect.

reference.description: Official cadastral reference of the parcel

name: get_neighbors
title: Get Neighboring Parcels
